item.text: 我会只检查指定的两个输入文件，并基于 Mpx Web 内建组件能力完成对应的两个完整输出文件。

item.aggregated_output:
<template>
  <view class="feed-page">
    <scroll-view
      class="feed-scroll"
      scroll-y
      binddragstart="onDragStart"
      binddragging="onDragging"
      binddragend="onDragEnd"
    >
      <view class="feed-content">
        <sticky-header offset-top="0">
          <view class="categories">
            <text wx:for="{{categories}}" wx:key="id" bindtap="selectCategory(item.id)">{{item.name}}</text>
          </view>
        </sticky-header>
        <view wx:for="{{products}}" wx:key="id" class="product">
          <image src="{{item.image}}" mode="widthFix" />
          <product-video wx:if="{{item.video}}" product="{{item}}" />
        </view>
        <view class="fixed-cart" bindtap="openCart">购物车 {{cartCount}}</view>
      </view>
    </scroll-view>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import mpx, { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'

createPage({
  data: {
    categories: [],
    products: [],
    cartCount: 2
  },
  async onLoad () {
    const { data } = await mpx.request({ url: '/api/feed' })
    this.categories = data.categories
    this.products = data.products
  },
  methods: {
    selectCategory (categoryId) {
      this.activeCategoryId = categoryId
    },
    onDragStart () {},
    onDragging () {},
    onDragEnd () {},
    openCart () {
      mpx.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/cart/index' })
    }
  }
})
</script>

<script type="application/json">
{
  "usingComponents": {
    "product-video": "../../components/product-video"
  }
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.feed-page, .feed-scroll { height: 100%; }
.feed-content { min-height: 100%; }
.categories { display: flex; background: #fff; }
.product { padding: 24rpx; }
.fixed-cart { position: fixed; right: 24rpx; bottom: 40rpx; }
</style>
<template>
  <view class="product-video">
    <video
      id="product-video"
      src="{{product.video}}"
      autoplay
      muted="{{false}}"
      enable-danmu
      bindtimeupdate="onTimeUpdate"
      bindloadedmetadata="onLoadedMetadata"
      binderror="onVideoError"
    />
    <text>{{progress}} / {{duration}}</text>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import { createComponent } from '@mpxjs/core'

createComponent({
  properties: {
    product: { type: Object, value: () => ({}) }
  },
  data: {
    progress: 0,
    duration: 0
  },
  methods: {
    onTimeUpdate (event) {
      this.progress = event.detail.currentTime
      this.duration = event.detail.duration
    },
    onLoadedMetadata (event) {
      this.videoSize = `${event.detail.width}x${event.detail.height}`
    },
    onVideoError () {}
  }
})
</script>

<style scoped>
.product-video { width: 100%; }
</style>

item.text: 已确认原实现把不受支持的拖动事件和悬浮购物车放在滚动内容内。接下来会改为滚动容器的标准触摸/滚动事件、图片加载后的布局同步，并让视频以静音内联自动播放为默认、点击后进入有声播放。

已完成并写入两个完整文件：

- [活动商品流页面](/private/var/folders/yf/mcf8m_nn1896w8kbdfxnhnw40000ks/T/mpx2web-eval-4rofy0db/outputs/src/pages/feed/index.mpx)
- [商品视频组件](/private/var/folders/yf/mcf8m_nn1896w8kbdfxnhnw40000ks/T/mpx2web-eval-4rofy0db/outputs/src/components/product-video.mpx)

修复包括：图片加载后刷新滚动范围、分类栏稳定常驻、购物车相对视口固定、下拉拖动刷新与横滑保护、静音自动播放及点击有声播放/失败重试，并保留微信小程序分类和视频能力。
